log.reasoning:
I'm weighing whether to commit to killing all 11 today, since the pool is 40,000 after three traces and the double-count window works out to exactly 33 against the 30 threshold. The risk I'm watching is getting caught once the pool drops to 1,000 or below, which would cost half, and I'm also deciding which block of the day stays free for me.

I'm checking the afternoon-and-morning plan against the night-worker detail, which holds up. Excluding day workers and students still leaves the 40,000 pool as it is. So I'll split the eleven as ten quick and one timed in the afternoon, then update the notes.
